summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MeetFlow Schedule Polls (Doodle-like scheduling) feature. All 20 backend tests pass. Frontend UI fully functional - Schedule page, Create page, Detail page, and Public Poll page all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/schedule-polls creates poll with poll_id + share_token (auth required)
Backend: GET /api/schedule-polls lists polls with pagination and search (auth required)
Backend: GET /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id} returns full poll details (auth required)
Backend: GET /api/schedule-polls/public/{share_token} returns poll without auth
Backend: POST /api/schedule-polls/public/{share_token}/vote records vote with voter_name and slot votes
Backend: Vote update with same voter_name overwrites previous vote
Backend: POST /api/schedule-polls/public/{share_token}/comment adds comment
Backend: POST /api/schedule-polls/public/{share_token}/suggest adds new time slot (when allowed)
Backend: POST /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id}/confirm confirms slot and creates MeetFlow meeting
Backend: DELETE /api/schedule-polls/{poll_id} deletes poll (auth required)
Backend: All auth endpoints return 401 when not authenticated
Backend: Invalid share_token returns 404
Backend: Invalid slot_id on confirm returns 400
Backend: Suggestions rejected when allow_suggestions=false (400)
Frontend: Sidebar shows 'Scheduling' nav item with CalendarClock icon
Frontend: Schedule page (/schedule) lists polls with status badges (Offen/Bestaetigt), search, pagination
Frontend: Schedule Create page (/schedule/create) form with title, description, time slots, options
Frontend: Poll creation returns share URL and shows success screen
Frontend: Schedule Detail page (/schedule/{pollId}) shows voting matrix with scores
Frontend: Detail page shows 'BESTE' label on best time slot with green background
Frontend: Detail page shows confirm buttons when poll has votes
Frontend: Confirm creates MeetFlow meeting and shows meeting code in toast
Frontend: Public Poll page (/poll/{shareToken}) loads WITHOUT login
Frontend: Public page shows poll header, voting matrix, vote form
Frontend: Vote cycle works: click toggles none->yes->maybe->no->none
Frontend: Vote submission shows success toast 'Abstimmung gespeichert!'
Frontend: 'Antwort aendern' button allows changing vote
Frontend: Comments section with name, text, submit button
Frontend: 'Eigenen Termin vorschlagen' section for suggestions
